body: this should be reverted, but connectHits will fail its types
actually all places that have `extends BaseHits = BaseHit` probably should just be `= Record<string, unknown>` instead
couldn't avoid this change, if it's using TWidgetParams, the generic from the connector is present in the widget, which isn't readable in the .d.ts rollup

this is actually used now as the default, and instead of `Hit<any>` it becomes `Hit<BaseHit>`, thus this needs to become any for the default, otherwise the new generic is essentially required to be filled in.
This is only properly asserted in type checking with `tsc`, right?
Are you confident import statements mixing types and values work in target frameworks? I remember having issues in the past with this.
yes, we don't really have type-only tests, but tsc is asserting that there's no errors here
it's moved to the "widgets" file, still exported from here too through that `*`
eslint complains that it's needed for "decorator metadata", probably as a false positive. Will ignore the rule instead indeed

sure, removed them just in case, probably some older tools don't remove them properly? in a major we can definitely be more consistent though (and probably export all types, but I'd do that in a separate PR)
Ah yes, I see it now.
